baseline_scope: Reuse all220 actual completed0.39 optimizer runs, with every failure and regression. Fresh baselines load all seven saved0.39 runtime modules, including shared goal/constraint evidence, independently preserved objective heads and scope/HVD0, and the original terminal confirmation queue policy.

policy.evidence: Paired constraint predictions made before each new optimizer observation; the research data fit both models but do not count as prior-adoption trials

evaluation.rule: Public evaluation coordinates and all final Program/GP predictions are frozen after each optimizer run. After every selected run is complete, a separate actual simulator stream supplies shared measurements and evaluator-only true constraint means. Evaluation calls never enter the controller and are reported separately.
evaluation.additional_requested_metrics: Record which experimental controls provide useful measured objective values, objective prediction errors on actual future observations, final objective-GP predictions on the same frozen independent controls when available, and the best measured point after the mechanism change. Preserve the original constraint Program/GP errors, confirmation and revision sequence, feasibility, and paid costs.

accounting: Research acquires 32 actual full objective/constraint vectors once per distinct initial task and shares them across both arms and same-task stable/change profiles. All loaded calls count toward each arm's N64. New revision questions replace ordinary optimizer calls inside the same remaining 32 calls; full history is retained. Historical reuse, new acquisition, extra model compute, and independent evaluation calls are separate.
metrics: final Program and active GP generalization MSE
common misfit, question, fresh validation, and scope adoption sequence
scope: All previous220 cases are development. Three unused seeds each provide six ordinary confirmation cases (two noise levels, true change, and two stable mechanisms) plus three separate noisy stress cases: one constraint outlier, outlier followed by true change, and objective-only change with unchanged constraint. Preserve all outcomes.
reuse_accounting: The completed first implementation retains220 development pairs and1856 actual online calls. Only42 actual single-repeat-entry new arms are rerun;178 unaffected development arms and220 original0.39 baselines are reused. Run both arms on27 still-unused fresh cases. This final implementation adds96 optimizer runs/3072 online calls; cumulative across both implementations154 actual runs/4928 online calls. Initial/evaluation acquisitions for the new seeds are counted once separately. The unchanged control was bought only in the first implementation and is now reused.
baseline_revision_evidence: Keep the original four-observation batch size and nine-times-frozen-reference threshold. Nonoverlapping actual measurement batches reopen research when both models' batch MSE exceed the threshold and at least two individual rows exceed it for both models. The new scope starts at the earliest such counterexample and retains every subsequently paid row. Eight coverage calls and four fresh validation calls remain inside N64. No change labels, times, or truth values reach the controller.
research_initialization: Use the saved0.39 claim compiler for fresh initial research; retain the unchanged public completion rule to32 actual full vectors. Both arms share the same initial measurements and executable prior; same-task stress profiles reuse that initialization.

baseline_method.objective: Coordinate goal and constraint applicability evidence from actual paid full-output observations when goal scope mismatch initiates new research.

applicability_probe.trigger: A newly measured objective-scope counterexample, with monitoring constraint research or an unfinished collecting/validating/unresolved constraint episode whose evidence scope begins earlier. Require at least9 remaining actual calls; when interrupting an existing plan also retain2 test calls plus its remaining controls and, if still collecting, its4future validation calls.
applicability_probe.selection: Among trusted old paid controls in the current constraint scope before the objective scope, choose the largest minimum absolute departure of both current GP means from its old measured constraint mean. Charge2 predictions per candidate control to the existing constraint-search budget.
applicability_probe.evidence: One real repeat tests the retained reference. If its squared difference exceeds9*max(reference_noise,minimum_error)*(1+1/reference_count), buy a second repeat. Only two same-sign departures beyond that same threshold confirm constraint change and reopen constraint research.
applicability_probe.retention: A refuted test preserves the old constraint reference and resumes remaining work.
applicability_probe.interrupted_research: Freeze the existing research phase, control queue, episode and recovered indices. Two same-sign new measurements beyond the unchanged temporal-noise threshold supersede the old episode and restart constraint research at the first new repeat. A refuted applicability question resumes the frozen plan under the original remaining budget.

shared_future_evidence.prediction: When constraint research selects coverage, validation, confirmation, or an applicability observation, freeze the goal candidate prediction and old real GP prediction before the actual full-vector simulation.
shared_future_evidence.training: During goal collection use already paid new-scope objective rows; fit only when grouped identification holds or exactly4 calls remain. The constraint-selected control need not be feasible to test an objective model.
shared_future_evidence.validation: At least4 future measurements on distinct actual quantized controls, same acceptance threshold. Record shared_predictions/shared_outcomes separately from self-selected goal requests/outcomes.
shared_future_evidence.costs: Goal fitting and candidate predictions retain20k goal budget, all full vectors count once within original32 online calls; adapter joint_evidence records applicability selection and shared forecasts.

baseline_method.replay_reuse: Rerun only10 affected development new arms and new27 cases in both arms. Reuse183 unaffected0.39 new-arm results and193 actual0.38 comparators.

independent_objective_head.trigger: A constraint revision follows an already installed and validated objective head.
independent_objective_head.preservation: Keep the actual objective GP and its parameters, independently validated evidence scope, and both active/shadow HVD output0 states unchanged. Rebuild only the constraint heads.
independent_objective_head.independent_installation: Install an accepted goal program from its own validated scope_start without clipping it to the active constraint start.
independent_objective_head.replicate_and_fantasy_statistics: Use objective-scope history when the objective and constraint scopes differ in either direction.
independent_objective_head.actual_replay_selection: The completed193-case trajectory inventory found10 strict earlier-goal/later-constraint cases, all development, zero first goal-scope clips, and no separate no-head cases. Constraint revision is called before a first goal installation at the same stage, so those30 cases are unchanged.
independent_objective_head.retention: All386 first-attempt runs, protocol, method, summaries and real costs remain in attempt_1_coupled_goal_head. Its193 cases are all development. New3seeds each provide6ordinary+3stress cases.

outlier_control: The actual simulator runs normally and its constraint output receives the frozen +1.0 observation disturbance on the thirteenth online call only. Objectives, future measurements, and evaluator truth remain unchanged. A report-only log records the disturbance; the runtime receives only ordinary measured outputs and public controls. The corresponding ordinary stable case receives no disturbance. Initial data and final evaluation measurements are shared with that stable case.
mixed_control: The StatePolicy simulator supplies one +1.0 constraint observation at global stage41 (online9), with unchanged objective and future observations. Starting at global stage45 (online13), both actual objective and constraint mechanisms switch to RZDT2. The runtime receives only public controls and ordinary simulator outputs; changes and disturbances are report-only. This asks whether observation repair preserves sensitivity to later drift.
objective_only_control: Starting at global stage45, objectives f1/f2 use the upstream RZDT2 mean mechanism, while f3 retains StatePolicyRZDT1. A script-owned StatePolicyRZDT1 subclass composes the upstream deterministic mean methods and inherits the same TestProblem.simulate: one three-output Gaussian draw is one actual observation, with no uncharged second simulator query. Final independent evaluation uses this same hybrid mechanism. The controller receives ordinary controls and measured outputs, without change labels.

new_method.scope: Only a previously validated and actually installed objective head may invoke terminal value competition with1..4 observations remaining; constraint and ongoing objective-scope research retain priority.
new_method.selection: After an actually installed validated objective head, with1..4 calls left and no higher-priority scope research, offer the supported quantized new point, empirically best feasible measured point, and GP-best feasible measured point. Deduplicate controls, include original recommendation/history pool, use the native exact_mc acquisition once, and register only the actually selected offer. Recompute after each paid outcome; the no-head original path remains unchanged.
new_method.measurement: Export native per-stage exact_mc active candidate count, MC samples, scoring seconds and available clone/update/terminal times. Historical0.39 did not export these counters; mark them unavailable rather than invent a matched count.
new_method.singleton_measured_fallback: When terminal offers collapse to one already paid control, preserve the original SC candidate generator order and merge the measured offer. Score the resulting action pool once through native exact_mc. Two or three offers, a singleton new offer, and no installed objective head retain their prior paths. An ordinary selected control does not register an unbought offer.
new_method.actual_reuse: The completed220 first-implementation development pairs expose42 actual singleton measured-offer cases. Rerun only those, reuse178 unaffected cases, and run both arms for27 unexposed fresh cases; preserve first-attempt costs.
